12 "normal" habits that are
actually quietly toxic

1. checking your phone while
someone talks to you

2. bonding only by complaining

3. treating gossip as entertainment

4. jokes at someone's expense

5. saying yes to everything

6. losing sleep to look busy

7. posting your whole life
for strangers

8. comparing yourself to everyone

9. pretending to know everything

10. never saying sorry

11. never being alone
with your thoughts

12. scrolling until 2am

i replaced it with one
short lesson in bed.
